readerTask.description: What the reader does after reading. Closed enum; see taxonomy/reader-tasks.json for definitions.

genre.description: Closed enum. Widen it only alongside content that uses the new value; must stay equal to the ids in taxonomy/genres.json.

genreScope.description: "any" for a task-general principle, or a non-empty list of specific genres for a convention.

writingLang.description: A language this rule governs the reader's text in -- not the language its own body prose is written in.

bilingualRule.description: At most one or two sentences. Rendered verbatim into core/*.md and a SKILL.md's generated block, so it must stand alone without the body.

evidenceStrength.description: How strong this source's support is, independent of whether it was actually re-verified (see sourceConfidence for that).

sourceSupports.description: What this source is cited for: the rule itself, that violating it harms a reader, or only that a pattern occurs at some frequency (a detection signal, not a harm).

verified_on.description: The last date this source was actually re-checked against the live page or document -- not the file's creation or edit date.

strongVerified.description: A source actually re-checked (not just recalled) and strong enough to carry an active rule: a standard, an empirical study, or an expert guide -- not a practitioner post or anecdote alone.
